arabic_html:
كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۖ
ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ ۞
translation: Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr, plainly: every soul shall taste death — then to Us you shall be returned. Not an end, but a return. It reframes everything you chase today.
